title: Modelling mouse embryogenesis from chemically induced totipotent stem cells
title_zh: 从化学诱导的多能干细胞模拟小鼠胚胎发生
abstract: The ability to faithfully initiate embryogenesis from a single, induced non-germline cell type, akin to the totipotent blastomeres, remains a considerable challenge in developmental and synthetic biology1-14. Here we established conditions that enable the continuous ex utero development of mouse embryo models (EMs), starting solely from the chemically induced totipotent-like stem cells (ciTotiSCs)15 and spanning the pre-implantation morula, blastocysts and post-gastrulation stages with both embryonic and extraembryonic compartments. These ciTotiSCs self-organized into blastocyst-like structures that closely resembled natural blastocysts in both morphology and lineage segregation. The resulting ciTotiSC-derived EMs (ciToti-EMs) successfully progressed through key developmental milestones, including gastrulation, embryonic axis formation, haematopoiesis and early organogenesis, closely resembling embryonic day 8.5 (E8.5) natural embryos (NEs). Furthermore, extended culture led to the development of functional cardiac tissues in ciToti-EMs, highly comparable to those of E10.5 NEs. These findings demonstrate an extraordinary ability of a single induced cell type, ciTotiSCs, to autonomously recapitulate the complete spectrum of early mouse embryogenesis. Our ciToti-EM system provides a powerful model for investigating mammalian embryonic development and opens new avenues for creating multicellular organisms from non-germline cells.
abstract_zh: 从单个诱导非生殖细胞类型（类似于多能早期胚胎细胞）可靠地启动胚胎发生，仍然是发育生物学和合成生物学中的重大挑战1-14。在此，我们建立了条件，使得仅从化学诱导的多能类干细胞（ciTotiSCs）出发，能够在体外连续发育小鼠胚胎模型（EMs），并覆盖从前蚓期、囊胚到胚蚓期以及有胚外层的关键发育阶段。这些ciTotiSCs自我组装成类似自然囊胚的结构，在形态和细胞谱系分化方面均与自然囊胚高度相似。所得的ciTotiSC来源胚胎模型（ciToti-EMs）成功经历了关键发育里程碑，包括胚蚓化、胚轴形成、血液形成和早期器官发生，与自然胚胎胚日8.5（E8.5）相近。此外，长期培养导致ciToti-EMs发育出功能性心脏组织，与E10.5自然胚胎高度相似。这些发现展示了单个诱导细胞类型ciTotiSCs自主重现小鼠早期胚胎发生完整光谱的非凡能力。我们的ciToti-EM系统为研究哺乳动物胚胎发育提供了强大模型，并为从非生殖细胞创建多细胞生物开辟了新途径。
